omissionAudit.method: Exact /v1/models IDs minus every candidate.model and candidate.aliases; same credentials, separate synthetic UUID sessions. No approximate normalization used for coverage.
limitations: No admin credentials or private account snapshots were queried. The exact list-source cause (live manifest, cache, account defaults, mapping or upstream catalog) cannot be established from public APIs alone.
Similar spelling, prefixes and date suffixes do not establish equivalent models; no aliases were added.
Account compatibility eligibility is not a live inference success certificate.

groups.evidence: backend/internal/handler/auto_model.go:autoModelTextCandidate excludes image and video substrings. These six are absent entirely, so the live plan supplies no reason for them.

Similar candidate names are recorded only for review. claude-haiku-4-5 is a platform-level alias in backend/internal/pkg/claude/constants.go, but absent from this plan aliases. Other equivalences unverified.
Exact missing names have date suffixes. qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902 exists as a different candidate name; alias equivalence unverified.
No exact candidate.model or candidate.aliases entry in either observed plan.

omissionAudit.suggestion: Unify discovery and auto inventory sources; represent discovery-only IDs as ineligible with explicit source/reason unless account capability evidence supports them. Do not make metadata-only entries eligible or merge similar IDs without upstream proof.
